audit_metadata.title: Recommended Configuration Changes for Kukule Ganga Hydropower Simulation
audit_metadata.target_facility: Kukule Ganga Power Station, Sabaragamuwa Province, Sri Lanka
audit_metadata.governance_rule: Do not overwrite baseline configuration or regenerate datasets without explicit approval of these recommended changes.

recommended_parameter_modifications.why_needed: The baseline 29.5 MASL was an arbitrary proxy. The newly supplied gross head benchmark (186.4 m at FSL 206.0 MASL) physically implies an effective operational tailwater elevation of 19.60 MASL under rated discharge. The outfall invert (13.52 MASL) cannot be used directly without accounting for the 9.28 m tailrace incline and hydraulic flow depth.
recommended_parameter_modifications.effect_on_simulation: Gross head increases from [174.75, 176.50] m to [184.40, 186.40] m, correctly reflecting the physical elevation drop to the draft tube manifold.

recommended_parameter_modifications.why_needed: The baseline 2.50 m accounted only for estimated headrace skin friction. The supplied maximum net head benchmark (176.1 m at FSL under rated flow) establishes that total system hydraulic losses (intake, trash racks, 5.8 km tunnel, surge shaft, penstocks, valves, draft tube, and 1.6 km tailrace) equal exactly 10.30 m (186.4 - 176.1 = 10.30 m).
recommended_parameter_modifications.effect_on_simulation: When combined with the 19.60 MASL tailwater, net head ranges exactly between 174.10 m (at MOL) and 176.10 m (at FSL), matching supplied benchmarks. Darcy-Weisbach headrace loss (3.11 m) must NOT be added on top to avoid double-counting.

recommended_parameter_modifications.why_needed: Supplied engineering details specify 204.00 MASL. The baseline 204.25 MASL was an earlier model assumption. Neither is officially verified with CEB rule curves in the repository.
recommended_parameter_modifications.effect_on_simulation: Expands active pond drawdown range from 1.75 m to 2.00 m. Active storage remains 1.67 MCM, resulting in a slightly expanded stage range.

recommended_parameter_modifications.why_needed: Supplied engineering details specify 24.0 m3/s per unit at 37.5 MW turbine output. The baseline was 23.75 m3/s.
recommended_parameter_modifications.effect_on_simulation: Station maximum hydraulic release increases from 47.5 m3/s to 48.0 m3/s (+1.05%). Marginal reduction in spillway discharge during peak monsoon events.

recommended_parameter_modifications.why_needed: Refines headrace chainage to 5,799 m as supplied.
recommended_parameter_modifications.effect_on_simulation: Metadata documentation update. Negligible standalone friction impact (+0.15%).

recommended_parameter_modifications.why_needed: Adds newly supplied circular waterway geometry parameter.
recommended_parameter_modifications.effect_on_simulation: Establishes finished tunnel area (24.63 m2) and rated flow velocity (1.95 m/s).

recommended_parameter_modifications.why_needed: Adds newly supplied tailrace tunnel geometry parameter.
Adds newly supplied longitudinal tunnel slope parameter.
recommended_parameter_modifications.effect_on_simulation: Establishes 9.28 m invert elevation drop between powerhouse and outfall portal.

recommended_parameter_modifications.why_needed: Adds newly supplied physical portal invert elevation.
recommended_parameter_modifications.effect_on_simulation: Defines physical outfall geometry; must NOT be used directly as operational tailwater.
Specification metadata only; no impact on water balance.
Specification metadata only; no impact on water balance.

turbine_maximum_output_per_unit_mw.action: Preserve as turbine runner peak mechanical output capability. Do not assume continuous electrical export capability without generator MVA, step-up transformer, and transmission verification. Keep nominal continuous station ceiling strictly at 70.0 MW.

generator_apparent_power_mva.action: 42.0 MVA aligns with 35.0 MW at 0.833-0.85 pf. 46.2 MVA is exactly 42.0 x 1.10 (10% continuous/2-hr overload). Must verify generator nameplate before modeling sustained generation above 35 MW/unit.

generator_power_factor_raw.action: Flagged as typographical source error for 0.85 (85%). Must not be silently altered in provenance audit.

annual_energy_raw.action: Flagged as typographical source error for ~317 GWh/year. Must not be silently converted in raw registry.
